title: Collections
description: Group your products into curated collections.

bulk.confirmDescription: This will permanently delete {count} collection(s). This action cannot be undone.

reorder.handle: Drag to reorder, or use arrow keys

rowActions.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete “{title}”. This action cannot be undone.

form.sheetDescription: Create a new collection. It will be added to the end of the list.
form.sheetDescriptionEdit: Update this collection’s details, status, and media.
form.name: Name
form.slugHint: Generated from the name until you edit this field.

hints.id: Permanent identifier for this collection. Used in the admin and APIs; it cannot be changed after creation.
hints.name: Public name shown in the storefront and collection pages.
hints.slug: URL path segment for this collection. Filled from the name until you edit it manually. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
hints.description: Marketing copy shown on the collection page and in previews.
hints.status: Draft collections are hidden from the storefront; active collections are visible to customers.
hints.coverImage: Cover image used on the collection page and in listings.

validation.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only

toast.createSuccessDescription: Your collection has been created successfully.
toast.errorDescription: The collection could not be created. Please try again.
toast.duplicateHandle: A collection with this URL slug already exists.
toast.reorderErrorDescription: The new collection order could not be saved. Please try again.
toast.deleteErrorDescription: The selected collections could not be deleted. Please try again.
toast.deleteHasProductsDescription: Reassign or remove products from these collections before deleting them.
